name: Eternal Portrait
description: Get an Eternal Knight. Start of Combat: Give your Eternal Knights Taunt and Reborn.

description: After you cast a Tavern spell, give your Deity +10/+10.

description: After you discard a spell, get a random Aberration.

name: Evil Experiment
description: After your Deity awakens, give it Reborn.

name: Sludge Portrait
description: Get a Sludge Corrosion. After you discard a card, get a Sludge Corrosion.

name: Makeshift Master
description: Spellcraft: Choose a minion. After it gains stats outside combat this turn, your Deity also gains them.

name: Tome of the Ancients
description: After you discard 3 cards, your Tavern spells give an extra +1/+1 this game. (3 left!)

name: Rascal Sticker
description: Gain 1 Gold for each friendly Golden minion. At the start of your turn, repeat this.

name: Converter Portrait
description: Get a Faceless Converter. Start of Combat: Give your Faceless Converters Reborn.

name: Trickster's Sleeve
description: After you buy a minion, gain 1 Gold. (Then swap to Tavern spell!)

name: Sinister Invitation
description: Discover a Golden minion of your most common type with a Dark Gift. It doesn't give a Triple Reward.

name: Tableware Portrait
description: Get a Menagerie Tableware. At the start of each turn, get another.

name: Demonic Bloodletter
description: Whenever you cast a Tavern spell, give minions in the Tavern +1/+1 this game.

name: Consuming Claw
description: Whenever a friendly Demon consumes a minion, it also gains its Bonus Keywords and +5/+5.
guide: Have some Fodder setup with [[Trapped Clapper||132897]] to stabilize.

name: Inductive Gyroblade
description: At the end of your turn, get a 12/12 Magnetic Satellite. (Improved by each Tavern spell you've cast this turn!)

name: Defensive Shell
description: The first minion you play each turn gains Divine Shield.

name: Emergency Gearblade
description: At the end of your turn, cast Repair Job on your left-most Mech.

name: Flighty Portrait
description: Get a Flighty Scout. After you cast a Tavern spell, give Flighty Scouts in your hand and warband +3/+3.
guide: Must already have Flighty Scout. Buy cheap spells to scale them.

name: Bloodfury Shield
description: Whenever you cast a Tavern spell, add a Fodder to your next Refresh.
guide: Use [[Devilish Distractor||132901]] + [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] setup and this trinket for shop buff payoff.

name: Cookie's Stirring Rod
description: After you play 5 Murlocs, get two random Tavern spells. (5 left!)

name: Willbreaker Sticker
description: Get 2 random Tavern spells. When you play one, discard the other. At the start of your turn, repeat this.

name: Privateer Portrait
description: Get a Proud Privateer and 2 random Bounties. At the start of each turn, get another 2 Bounties.

name: Soul Fermenter
description: Start of Combat: Destroy your 3 left-most minions. After your last minion dies, resummon them.

name: Dramaloc Sticker
description: Start of Combat: Give your Murlocs the Attack of the highest-Attack minion in your hand.

name: Groundbreaker Portrait
description: Get a Groundbreaker. Your Groundbreakers also give stats to the minion to their left.

name: Plaguerunner Portrait
description: Get a Plaguerunner. After you destroy a Plaguerunner outside combat, get a plain copy.

name: Mindslasher Portrait
description: Get a Vicious Mindslasher. Your Vicious Mindslashers also give stats to adjacent minions.

name: Quartermaster's Hook
description: After you spend 50 Gold, replace this with a random Greater Pirate Trinket. (50 Gold left!)

name: Mask of Ancient Ones
description: Make your Deity Golden this game.

name: Nerglish Phrasebook
description: After you play a minion, give the left-most minion in your hand +6/+6.

name: Great Boar Sticker
description: Get 5 Blood Gems. Your Blood Gems give an extra +3/+3.

name: Makeshift Master
description: Choose a minion. After it gains stats outside combat this turn, your Deity also gains them.

name: The Eye of Sargeras
description: Every fourth card you buy costs Health instead of Gold. (3 left!)
guide: Great trinket when committed to Shop Buff Demons. Also want a [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] and [[Soul Rewinder||100949]] in your setup.

name: Reinvigorating Light
description: Discover a second Hero Power. Gain 3 Gold.

name: Weighted Gauntlet
description: At the end of your turn, give your minions +1/+1. (Doubles at the start of each turn!)

name: Surveyor Portrait
description: Get a Hot-Air Surveyor. Blood Gems played from your hand give an extra +6/+6.

name: Bassgill Portrait
description: Get a Bassgill. After you summon a Murloc in combat, give it Divine Shield.
